messages:
sara_p: Heads-up — GlacierHealth arch review tomorrow 10:00am PST with Orion SI. They want a short preflight so the call doesn't get bogged down. @mike_s @raj_arch can you confirm who owns which checklist items? :spiral_calendar:

mike_s: I can take marketplace + billing boundary items. Quick question — are they going Dedicated or Private? That changes network stuff.

sara_p: They signed up for Private (VPC peering + on-prem connector). Orion SI doing install.

raj_arch: Ok. I'll cover network/auth and certs. Top risks to call out:
- cross-account IAM roles for S3 model artifacts
- egress constraints (customer may block outbound)
- image signing + attestation for on-prem images
- HSM/KMS for key management

louise_eng: I'll own runtime sizing and kernel/quant settings. For Private we usually recommend:
- 8xA10G (or 4xA100) equivalent for 1k rps of short chat flows
- enable KV-cache and prefix caching in config
- quantize to int8 if legal/quality OK

anita_orion: From Orion SI side — customer already stated that outbound Internet is minimized. They can allow outbound to a small IP set if we give CIDR. Also they require image hash verification before deploy. Can you provide the exact SNAT/egress endpoints?

raj_arch: We'll need these network endpoints for preflight:
- registry.redwood-inference.net:443 (image pull)
- artifacts.redwood-inference.net:443 (model downloads)
- telemetry.redwood-inference.net:443 (optional for observability)
- sts.amazonaws.com (for STS assume-role, if using cross-account)

sara_p: Copying that to the partner note. @mike_s do we have a marketplace SKU to reference? Their procurement asks for the SKU for invoicing.

mike_s: Not a Marketplace SKU — this is private install contract. I'll attach the order reference in the meeting invite.

louise_eng: Two quick implementation notes to flag on the call:
1) If they truly block outbound, we need to stage model artifacts inside their registry before hand (we can provide a signed OCI image).
2) KV-cache warmup: plan an initial synthetic traffic job to pre-populate KV so first 500 users don't hit cold-starts.

raj_arch: Also add this snippet for their infra team to test connectivity to our artifact endpoint (can run from jump host):

```
curl -v https://artifacts.redwood-inference.net/healthz --resolve artifacts.redwood-inference.net:443:52.12.34.56
```

sara_p: Nice. I put that into the meeting doc: https://redwood.ai/notes/glacierhealth-preflight (internal).

anita_orion: One more — customer mandates signed images and that only images with SBOM are allowed. What are our current SBOM export options?

louise_eng: We can generate an SPDX SBOM and sign the image with cosign. Example flow:
```
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/…/key artifacts.redwood-inference.net/glacier-agent:1.2.3
cosign verify artifacts.redwood-inference.net/glacier-agent:1.2.3
```
We can hand them the pubkey.

mike_s: For the call: I'll run the first 10 minutes on procurement and contract, then hand to @raj_arch for network + security. @louise_eng you take runtime/config, @anita_orion you handle install sequencing. Sara will run the 'open issues' tracker.

sara_p: Agreed. I'll send a 10min pre-call at 9:40am for quick sync. Agenda in doc.

deploy-bot: Deployment plan job #5571: preflight checklist template created by sara_p — https://ci.redwood/plan/5571 (status: draft) :white_check_mark:

anita_orion: Thanks all. One ask — can you confirm TTL on signed artifacts? Their security team requires signatures rotate every 90 days.

raj_arch: We support rotation. We'll note rotation cadence and key rotation playbook in the post-call action items.

sara_p: Perfect. I added action items and assigned owners in the doc. See you on the call. :wave:
